title: Werkstudent Video Editor / Cutter Social Media (m/w/d)
description: Du studierst, schneidest in deiner Freizeit schon Reels und Sport ist fester Teil deines Lebens? Wir sind GORNATION, eine Sportmarke aus Münster, gegründet 2015 mit der Mission, Calisthenics weltweit zu stärken. Unsere Produkte werden in über 100 Ländern genutzt, von Trainings-Equipment bis Streetwear. Auf Instagram erreichen wir über 270.000 Menschen. Damit unser Short Form Output weiter wächst, suchen wir Verstärkung für unser Content- und Social-Media-Team. Als Werkstudent schneidest du Reels, Shorts und TikToks für Organic & Paid Social und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Dabei sammelst du echte Praxis mit Content, der live geht und performt. Wir planen langfristig: Unser Ziel ist, dass du nach deinem Abschluss 2027 voll bei uns einsteigst. Arbeitsmodell: 15–20 Stunden/Woche, flexibel planbar rund um deine Vorlesungen, vor Ort in Münster. Start ab sofort, mit der Perspektive auf eine Übernahme in Vollzeit 2027. Aufgaben Organic Content schneiden: Aus Rohmaterial, Athleten-Content, Shootings, UGC und Produktvideos machst du Reels, Shorts und TikToks für unsere Kanäle. Paid Ads umsetzen: Du schneidest Ad Creatives, mit unterschiedlichen Hooks, Längen, Seitenverhältnissen und Texteinblendungen. Außerdem passt du Videos für unseren Onlineshop an. Feedback umsetzen: Du stimmst dich eng mit Social Media, Content und Marketing ab und setzt Anpassungen schnell und sauber um. Trends scouten: Du beobachtest Sounds, Schnittstile und Formate und bringst passende Ideen für GORNATION ein. Drehs begleiten: Du unterstützt bei Shootings und filmst Reels, Ads und Behind-the-Scenes Clips mit Smartphone oder Kamera. Footage organisieren: Du sichtest, benennst und archivierst Material, damit das Team jederzeit schnell darauf zugreifen kann. Qualifikation Studium mit Abschluss 2027: Du bist an einer Universität oder Hochschule eingeschrieben und schließt dein Studium voraussichtlich im Laufe des nächsten Jahres ab. Ein Studium im Bereich Medien, Film oder Kommunikation ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Langfristige Perspektive: Du kannst dir vorstellen, nach dem Studium in Vollzeit bei uns einzusteigen. Sportbegeisterung: Du hast einen starken Bezug zu Sport, idealerweise zu Calisthenics oder Kraftsport. Du erkennst eine saubere Ausführung, weißt, welche Moves beeindrucken, und setzt Athleten so in Szene, dass die Community es feiert. Erste Editing-Erfahrung: Eigene Kanäle, Uni-Projekte oder Freelance-Jobs zählen genauso wie Berufserfahrung. Editing Tools: Du arbeitest sicher mit CapCut oder ähnlichen Programmen. Gespür für Short Form: Du weißt, wie ein starker Hook aussieht, schneidest dynamisch statt nur schnell und kannst einschätzen, ob ein Video performt. Zuverlässigkeit & Struktur: Du hältst Deadlines und Absprachen ein und arbeitest sauber, auch wenn es mal schnell gehen muss. Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch, sodass du Captions und Texteinblendungen sicher umsetzen kannst. Lernbereitschaft: Du nimmst Feedback gerne an und willst dich im Editing konstant weiterentwickeln. Nice-to-have: Du filmst sicher mit der Kamera und hast Erfahrung im Schnitt von YouTube-Videos. Außerdem sind After Effects, Motion Design, Photoshop, Canva oder Asana ein Plus. Benefits Klare Perspektive: Wir stellen dich mit dem Ziel ein, dich nach deinem Abschluss in Vollzeit zu übernehmen. Flexible Planung: Deine Arbeitszeiten stimmen wir auf deinen Stundenplan und deine Prüfungsphasen ab. Top Arbeits-Equipment: Du bekommst ein MacBook für deine Arbeit. Fitness inklusive: Wir trainieren regelmäßig gemeinsam nach der Arbeit, entweder im Office-Gym oder draußen. Steuerfreier Sachbezug: Du erhältst eine Sport-Mitgliedschaft, eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung oder eine Tankkarte als steuerfreien Sachbezug. Teamevents & Networking: Neben Teamevents lernst du internationale Calisthenics-Athleten kennen. FIBO erleben: Mit einem 4-Tage-Ticket bist du auf der internationalen Fitnessmesse in Köln dabei. Exklusive Rabatte: Du bekommst Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unser Equipment und unsere Kleidung. Office-Extras: Höhenverstellbare Schreibtische, Kaffee- und Wasser-Flat, hundefreundliches Büro nach Absprache und eine E-Auto-Ladestation am Campus. Du willst neben dem Studium Content schneiden, der wirklich gesehen wird und danach bei uns durchstarten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Schick uns 3-5 Beispiele deiner Reels, Shorts oder TikToks, gerne auch private Projekte, und nenn uns deinen voraussichtlichen Abschlusstermin. The ideal candidate is a driven, curious and client-obsessed professional, who thrives in complex, fast-moving environments and brings the energy and structure needed to turn ambition into results.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What you will do at Mirakl</strong></h2> <p>The Experienced Customer Success Consultant will have a strong impact on Mirakl Ads growth, managing a portfolio of key clients across all stages of their journey.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead clients from strategy to implementation</strong>: define their Retail Media vision and Mirakl Ads roadmap, design the right organizational setup, co-build a sharp commercial action plan with the right KPIs, and drive execution - ensuring a successful and lasting integration of Retail Media into their business, from first workshops through go-live and beyond</li> <li><strong>Deliver strategic recommendations</strong> at business reviews, presenting to client teams and C-levels, sharing market insights and case studies to inspire performance and long-term growth</li> <li><strong>Design and implement</strong> the right KPI frameworks to monitor clients' advertising network performance and continuously identify growth levers</li> <li><strong>Support clients</strong> in the day-to-day optimization of their Mirakl Ads use (placements, campaign configuration, etc.), ensuring platform adoption and maximizing advertising revenues</li> <li><strong>Lead tailored workshops and training sessions</strong> to ensure optimal onboarding and sustained platform mastery over time</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>As part of a growing and structured team, you will also:</p> <ul> <li>Contribute to the continuous improvement and industrialization of Customer Success processes and tooling, ensuring scalable and efficient operations as the Mirakl Ads client base grows. Collaborate with BI teams to analyze client activity and monitor advertising network performance</li> <li>Leverage AI tools and capabilities to enhance the way we deliver value to clients and scale our operations - from automating reporting and insights generation to accelerating strategic recommendations and improving the overall client experience</li> <li>Act internally as the voice of the Publisher, providing Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams with actionable insights on how Mirakl Ads fits and solves client needs at scale</li> <li>Stay ahead of market trends and competitive dynamics in the Retail Media industry, translating intelligence into strategic recommendations for clients and internal teams</li> <li>Contribute your vision in meetings with adtech partners to strengthen Mirakl's positioning in the adtech value chain and support the growth of our global Advertising Services initiative</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What Mirakl is looking for</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Master's Degree in Business or Engineering</li> <li>3+ years of experience in retail media, the eCommerce industry, or in a consulting firm with strong exposure to digital advertising and/or marketplace ecosystems</li> <li>Solid knowledge of eCommerce, marketplace, and online advertising, with a strong understanding of adtech value chains</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills</li> <li>Strong client-facing and project management skills</li> <li>Highly business-driven with strong analytical skills, thriving in dynamic environments</li> <li>Someone eager to thrive in a scaling business environment, contributing to the continuous improvement of the Mirakl Ads Customer Success practice</li> <li>Fluency in English is a must-have; German and/or French is a strong asset, given our key markets.</li> <li>Self-motivated and energetic, with experience managing multiple internal stakeholders to deliver commercial goals</li> <li>Strong organizational skills and attention to detail</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.</em></p> <p><em>As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in English and <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/fr-FR/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in French.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.</p> <p>At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.</p> <p>Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.</p> <h4><strong>Your Impact</strong></h4> <p>As a <strong>Senior Search Engineer</strong> on our <strong>Discovery Team</strong>, you will build the retrieval layer behind product discovery for some of the world’s most demanding commerce brands.</p> <p>Search is changing shape. Shoppers type full sentences instead of keywords, and increasingly the client calling our API is an AI agent rather than a person. We are on the path to take our semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability, and tackling the hard problems: making it fast, affordable, measurably better across enterprise catalogs, and working out what comes after it. You would join that work at every layer, from query understanding down to the vector index and the cost of a single query.</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend.</li> <li>Develop in a scalable and multi-tenant architecture.</li> <li>Analyze user needs and discuss technical approaches.</li> <li>Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps.</li> <li>Take part in on-call rotations with a worldwide distributed team for production systems</li> </ul> <p><em>This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our</em><strong><em> Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia</em></strong><em> office.&nbsp;</em></p> <h4><strong>What Sets You Apart</strong></h4> <p>You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.</p> <p>Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.</p> <p>You bring:</p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer working in search.</li> <li>Experience with building search solutions on top of engines, such as Elasticsearch (preferred), Solr, OpenSearch, or similar.</li> <li>Aspiration to constantly improve yourself and learn new technologies, concepts, etc.</li> <li>Fluent English communication skills to work in international teams.</li> <li>AI Aptitude<strong>:</strong> A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.</li> </ul> <p>Nice to Have:<strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience using modern search stacks and strategies to optimize search relevance (Vector and Hybrid Search, Learning to rank, Re-ranker)</li> <li>Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures (incl., queues, notification topics, sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover).</li> <li>Experience working with Scala or other functional programming languages.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust.&nbsp;</li> </ul> </div> </section> </div> <h4><strong>Our Benefits</strong></h4> <p>Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.</p> <p>🩺 <strong>Comprehensive health benefits</strong> for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support</p> <p>📚 <strong>Learning and development </strong>opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs</p> <p>🍼 <strong>Family Leave Plus</strong> gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition</p> <p>📈 <strong>Our equity participation program</strong> allows you to share in our success&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information on our benefits, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/our-benefits">visit this page.</a></p> <p><strong>Come as you are. Build with us.</strong></p> <p>Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.</p> <p>We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community.&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/dei-esg">visit this page</a>.&nbsp;</p> </div> </section> </div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We create AI-powered solutions that help health professionals focus on care and help people prevent, detect, and treat health problems earlier. href="https://medium.com/doctolib/building-for-healthcare-our-first-ai-hackathon-aa9d10d1a250">here</a>!</li> </ul> <p>If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest<a href="https://medium.com/doctolib"> Medium blog articles</a>!</p> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you depth of medical knowledge.</li> <li>Dutch language skills.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A structured and personalized <strong>onboarding program</strong> <strong>subsidies for your lunch or grocery shopping</strong>.</li> <li>A <strong>Deutschlandticket</strong> sponsored by Doctolib, or <strong>reimbursement of your semester ticket</strong>.</li> <li>A <strong>flexible workplace policy</strong> offering up to <strong>2 days of hybrid work</strong> per week.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>The interview process</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An interview with our Talent Partner (30 minutes).</li> <li>An interview with the hiring manager (30 minutes).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Job details</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Contract Type: Internship (Mandatory/Voluntary)</li> <li>Working Time: Full-time</li> <li>Duration: 6 months</li> <li>Work model: Hybrid</li> <li>Location: Berlin, Germany.</li> <li>Expected start date: January 2027<strong><br><br></strong></li> </ul> <p>At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This commitment is reflected in our hiring process, where we assess applications based solely on qualifications, potential, and motivation, without discrimination of any kind.</p> <p>We believe that diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences help us build better healthcare products. If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know and we will do our best to support you.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Data privacy</strong></p> <p><em>All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. While the role involves technical collaboration across the organisation, it is primarily focused on engineering rather than stakeholder management.&nbsp;</p> <p>This will be a full-time role, owning the following <strong>responsibilities</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that support data ingestion, processing and distribution.&nbsp;</li> <li>Build and maintain reliable data ingestion pipelines for structured and unstructured data from a wide variety of internal and external sources.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop reusable frameworks and tooling that simplify onboarding new data sources and improve developer productivity.&nbsp;</li> <li>Design and optimise scalable data platforms including databases, data lakes, metadata&nbsp;catalogues and storage solutions.&nbsp;</li> <li>Continuously improve the reliability, scalability, observability and cost-efficiency of our data infrastructure.&nbsp;</li> <li>Integrate data across multiple systems while reducing duplication and ensuring high data quality.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop and maintain orchestration workflows and automated data processing pipelines.&nbsp;</li> <li>Build internal libraries and services that enable other engineering teams to access and consume data efficiently.&nbsp;</li> <li>Monitor, troubleshoot and optimise production systems and data pipelines.&nbsp;</li> <li>Contribute to architecture discussions and technical decisions across the data platform.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborate closely with software engineers, data engineers, infrastructure engineers and data consumers to deliver high-impact solutions.&nbsp;</li> <li>Continuously identify opportunities to simplify systems, improve automation and reduce operational overhead.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3><strong>About You</strong></h3> <p>This person will be an experienced Senior Data Engineer with hands-on backend development experience. RESTful APIs and backend services.</li> <li>Experience building and maintaining data pipelines or large-scale data processing systems.</li> <li>Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational impact.</li> </ul> <p>In addition, the following is not required, but highly desirable for this role:</p> <ul> <li>Experience working in a Commodities Trading House or Hedge Fund.</li> <li>Experience Translate regional marketing strategy into concrete, high-quality regional go-to-market plans. Lead the delivery of campaigns across digital, social, influencer, and partnership channels. Manage timelines, budgets, and scopes to ensure campaigns ship on time and at a high quality bar. Partner closely with local agencies, game teams, marketing strategists, and creatives to ensure smooth execution. Coordinate with creators, agencies, and external partners to deliver integrated campaigns. Oversee production across non-owned channels, events, and activations, ensuring consistency and accuracy. Track campaign performance and player response, sharing insights with stakeholders. Continuously improve execution quality by applying learnings and raising the bar over time. Capture learnings, identify execution improvements and proactively recommend ways to improve future campaigns.   • Partner closely with local agencies, game teams, marketing strategists, and creatives to ensure smooth execution.

  • Oversee production across non-owned channels, events, and activations, ensuring consistency and accuracy.

  • Strong experience executing marketing campaigns in EMEA and ideally DACH markets, France and the UK - preferably in gaming, entertainment, or consumer brands.

  • Deep understanding of DACH media, culture, and player behavior.

  • Hands-on experience across digital and social marketing, including influencer and creator collaborations.

  • Familiarity with broader media channels such as TV, CTV, audio, and out-of-home.

  • Proven ability to manage complex projects, timelines, and budgets.

  • Experience working with international teams across time zones.

  • Clear and concise communication skills with strong attention to detail.

  • A proactive, adaptable mindset and comfort working in a fast-moving environment.

  • Experience working on live games or live service products.

  • Familiarity with Supercell games or a strong interest in mobile and competitive gaming.

  • Experience executing campaigns across EMEA.

This is a remote role based in Berlin, Germany.

You'll work closely with teammates in Helsinki, London and partners across the region. This is a globally connected role, with travel expected to Helsinki on a regular basis with occasional international travel.

• First months: You're confidently executing campaigns aligned with global strategy, building strong relationships across teams, and ensuring smooth delivery.

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Anstellungsdetails

Permanent Contract, Full- or Part-Time, Remote or Cologne / Düsseldorf / Darmstadt / Berlin


Info

Who we areWe are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Driven by a start-up mentality and working on an equal footing within flat hierarchies, we develop the best marketplace solutions for our customers, sellers and partners. #FromEuropeForEurope

Day by day, our Tech & Product Team of about 400 experts pursues the goal of creating the best possible customer shopping experience for our online marketplace. Through innovative technical developments, they not only create an outstanding shopping experience but also lay the foundation for an optimal selling experience for our sellers. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!


Aufgaben

Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail

  • You lead the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for B2C products on the Kaufland Global Marketplace, aligning company goals with customer needs
  • You collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, data, and marketing, to deliver high-quality digital products
  • You design and ship LLM-powered product features that elevate the shopping experience and shape how people shop, from the first concept and prompt design through evaluation, quality monitoring, and continuous iteration in production
  • You drive a rigorous experimentation culture: you form hypotheses, design and run A/B tests, and turn results into product decisions that drive customer engagement and conversion
  • You define tracking concepts together with analytics teams and use funnel and behavioral data to continually optimize the product so customers can discover, evaluate, and buy the right products with ease
  • You work hand-in-hand with UX designers and researchers to craft intuitive customer journeys, validate them through user research and usability testing, and iterate fast
  • You identify customer needs and pain points at scale through behavioral data, user research, and market trends, and prioritize the opportunities that create the most value
  • You stay on top of AI and e-commerce trends and proactively identify how emerging technologies can create value for our customers


Profil

Your profile – this is what we expect from you

  • You have a true builder mindset and a passion for turning ideas into reality
  • You've successfully taken a product from scratch, owning everything from early ideation and concept development to execution and delivery
  • You have hands-on experience building LLM-based features into consumer products, not just using AI tools for your own productivity 
  • You bring solid B2C product experience, ideally in e-commerce or another consumer product at scale
  • You are data savvy and outcome-focused: you design and evaluate A/B tests, define tracking concepts, and answer the right questions based on data
  • You always think customer first: you have a strong feel for UX, understand end-users' pain points, and derive actionable insights from research and data
  • You are a motivated and empathetic communicator who is experienced in collaborating with software development teams and interacting with different stakeholders
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, pragmatic environment, bring fluent English skills (C1 level), and excel in an international, remote setup


Benefits

What we offer

  • Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin!
  • Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios: Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more
  • Mental Well-Being: We support you on your well-being journey with special offerings such as Instahelp, the digital platform for online psychological counseling
  • Vacation & Sabbatical: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year and the opportunity to take a sabbatical once you have been part of the team for a certain period!
  • Option for Pluxee restaurant vouchers: Buy Pluxee vouchers through us and benefit from tax-advantaged meal allowances!
  • ‘Deutschlandticket’: We subsidise your train season ticket for more mobility
  • Employee Discount: You will receive a monthly coupon for Kaufland.de
  • Free choice of hardware: Mac or Lenovo, it's up to you
  • Boost your growth: Benefit from our online language learning programs, diverse in-house training, and our automated 360-degree feedback
  • This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment.
  • We are team players: From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!
Check out our Principles & our blog for even more insights into our company culture!

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.&nbsp;</div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p>Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.</p> <p>We are seeking a Data Analyst III to join our Sportsbook organization in the Product Analytics team.</p> <p>This role will focus on creating insights to drive product development and enhance business performance. The individual will partner closely with senior stakeholders in the Sportsbook Product team and be responsible for supporting them with testing, performance tracking, reporting, and ad-hoc queries.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop a strong understanding of Fanatics Betting and Gaming, with particular focus on the Sportsbook.&nbsp;</li> <li>Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, becoming a key contributor to data-driven decision-making within the Sportsbook Product team.</li> <li>Support the Sportsbook Product team with testing, analysis and reporting as they develop the product and optimize user experiences.&nbsp;</li> <li>Be a hands-on analyst, creating insights both regular and ad hoc. Gather and present insights metrics and activities to key stakeholders, becoming a trusted source of intelligence and advisory over time.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborate with Analysts and Data Scientists to find solutions to business problems.</li> <li>Remain current on technology and trends in data analytics and the sports betting &amp; gaming industry.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>A minimum of 5 years proven experience in an analytics role</li> <li>Previous experience in the betting and gaming industry is a significant plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in a relevant field, e.g. Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Engineering, or Computer Science</li> <li>Strong SQL proficiency</li> <li>Proficiency in a statistical programming language, e.g. R or Python</li> <li>Proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools, e.g. Tableau or PowerBI</li> <li>Strong proficiency in data analysis or mathematical model development, with a strong understanding of statistics concepts such as multivariate testing</li> <li>Experience using code repositories, e.g. GitHub</li> <li>Experience with Amplitude a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Non technical skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated ability to partner closely with stakeholders, earning trust and prioritizing relationships</li> <li>Customer focused; highly outcome-oriented and data-driven; experienced in working in high-growth environments</li> <li>Logical and analytical approach to problem solving, with strong organizational and communication skills</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>For information about our benefits, please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£52,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£66,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our&nbsp;<a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.</p> <h4 data-start="2485" data-end="2493">Benefits</h4> <p data-start="2495" data-end="3375">· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p data-start="3377" data-end="3739">We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p data-start="3741" data-end="3752">Sponsorship</p> <p data-start="3754" data-end="3910">Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <h3 data-start="3912" data-end="3938">Join the Team at Graphcore</h3> <p data-start="3940" data-end="4219">Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p data-start="4221" data-end="4503">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p data-start="4829" data-end="4962" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">Ready to shape the architecture behind Graphcore’s next generation of AI acceleration platforms? description: <p><strong>Are you ready to unleash your entrepreneurial spirit and be a part of an exciting start-up revolution as the main driver for its growth and success?</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.cfoinsights.org/">CFO</a> Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.</p> <p>CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity.</strong></p> <p>As a MBA Graduate, you will run, grow and manage all aspects of CFO Insights. You will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team, ensuring the successful execution of the conference and strategy of the brand.&nbsp;</p> <p>You’ll want this job if you possess strong leadership skills, excellent communication abilities, highly ambitious, forward-thinking and driven to inspire and lead a team. You are someone who is thrilled to work in a fast-paced environment and wants to scale the company rapidly.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>Recruit, build and develop a high-performing team.&nbsp;</li> <li>Build an ecosystem and deliver outstanding products.</li> <li>Set clear expectations, establish goals, and provide ongoing detailed feedback and performance evaluations.</li> <li>Execute the strategy at a rapid pace.</li> <li>Develop the company’s brand as the go-to place for inspiration, knowledge and networking.&nbsp;</li> <li>Oversee planning, execution, and completion of conferences within the designated timelines and budget constraints.</li> <li>Assign tasks to team members in each department, monitor progress, and ensure project objectives are achieved.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to expand business with existing clients and collaborate with business development teams for new client acquisition.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>You’ll be working in person at our HQ in London (next to Sloane Square), constantly pushing you out of your comfort zone to ensure a never-ending growth curve for you and the business. We provide you with the following:</p> <ul> <li>The opportunity to lead, run and develop a fast-growing business, where your work and the results are highly tangible and make all the difference.&nbsp;</li> <li>Work with an incredible team with a track record of developing and growing businesses.&nbsp;</li> <li>Travel opportunity: You will be joining our conferences overseas.&nbsp;</li> <li>Competitive salary</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Requirement</strong></p> <ul> <li>+4 years’ experience from an institution with high speed and work ethic e.g. management consulting, investment banking, top-tier corporate or start-up.&nbsp;</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree with outstanding results, maybe followed by an MBA</li> <li>Strong commercial awareness and a passion for business.&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Proven track record delivering results.</li> <li>UK, EU or US work permit</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Marketing Graduate at CFO insights
description: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Marketing Graduate.</span></p> <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">CFO Insights is part of United Media (<a href="https://www.united-media.com/" target="_blank">https://www.united-media.com/</a>) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As our Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What we expect from you</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Startdate</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Flexible</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.</span></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Management Graduate Program Intake (Spanish speaker) CFO Insights
description: <p>Are you looking for challenges within an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? If so, now is the time to apply for our 4 months paid Internship Program in London.</p> <h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p>CFO Insights is part of United Media (<a href="https://www.united-media.com/">https://www.united-media.com/</a>) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conference products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.</p> <h3><strong>What we offer you</strong></h3> <p>As part of our Internship Program in London, you will rocket launch your career in a high-paced environment with a continuously steep learning curve. In short, we offer the brightest talents:</p> <ul> <li>An opportunity to fast-track your career through responsibility for high-impact projects that constantly push you out of your comfort zone</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and scaling ventures together with the sharpest minds</li> <li>An amazing network and the possibility of reporting directly to C-level staff and Managing Directors</li> <li>Given the opportunity to collaborate on projects with industry leaders&nbsp;</li> <li>Mentorship and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high-performing team as well as with the founder of our company, Mads Faurholt</li> <li>Potential for permanent employment after the internship</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your responsibilities</strong></h3> <p>You’ll be part of building and scaling companies, which, depending on the role you’ll take, could entail responsibilities such as:</p> <ul> <li>Supporting our recruitment function covering everything from candidate sourcing to speaking with potential candidates</li> <li>Being part of creating connections with key players from the industry, like CEOs, entrepreneurs, for example, co-founders of Airbnb, Starbucks etc. building and maintaining valuable relationships with them.</li> <li>Working on marketing and SoMe content creation by developing, implementing and managing social media and marketing strategy</li> <li>Data analysis; extracting the correct data for analysis, and ability to interpret and relay the data.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we expect from you</strong></h3> <p>You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you:</p> <ul> <li>Have or are in the process of finishing your bachelor's with outstanding results</li> <li>Have experience from part-time work and/or from extracurricular activities</li> <li>Are fluent in English, written and spoken.</li> <li>Have exceptional attention to detail</li> <li>Possess exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Starting day</strong></h3> <p>January 2024. Monday - Friday we work from our office (next to Victoria station) and do not offer remote work.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Graduate Social Media Manager.</span></p> <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">CFO Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As our Graduate Social Media Manager you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What we expect from you</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Startdate</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Flexible&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.</span></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d)
description: Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus Connected Growers entwickelt June - die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, B2B Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten. Deine Rolle bei June Als Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna. Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen. Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen. Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln. Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS . Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick. Anforderungen Was du mitbringst Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst. Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit. Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt. Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen). Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript. Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen. Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen. Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services. Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen. Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen.. Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen. So arbeiten wir Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu. Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button. Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten. Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten. Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen. Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft. Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen. Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über BridgeMaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
description: Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. Deine Rolle bei June Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. Anforderungen Was du mitbringst Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. So arbeiten wir Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. title: Applied ML Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied ML Engineer based in France. As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering. You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products. The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences. You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate. You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users. The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack. It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust. Accountabilities Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models. Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses. Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required. Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility. Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows. Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion. Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations. Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses. Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation. Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve. During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations. Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface. Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why. Requirements: Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers. Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility. Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages. Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation. Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate. Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users. Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests. High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently. Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions. Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus. Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous. Familiarity with evaluation and inference infrastructure such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Temporal, Ray, vLLM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, or comparable technologies is beneficial. Experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, data visualization, or experiment dashboards is a plus. Experience running and serving open-weight models on GPUs, including reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, precision, and cost trade-offs, is valuable. Experience designing adversarial evaluations or testing systems against deliberate attempts to evade detection is an advantage. A strong commitment to producing production-quality code, tests, tooling, and documentation that other engineers can confidently operate and extend. Benefits: Opportunity to work on applied machine learning at the intersection of research, experimentation, engineering, and product. End-to-end ownership across model evaluation, model internals, infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing experiences. Exposure to modern open-weight models, LLM inference systems, and emerging ML verification techniques. A role with significant technical autonomy and the opportunity to shape both experiments and production systems. Fast-moving startup environment with evolving priorities and cross-functional collaboration. Opportunity to translate cutting-edge research into practical, measurable, and user-accessible products. The opportunity to build systems and evaluation methodologies designed to produce evidence that users can understand and trust. Location: Romania. We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision making processes and challenge the status quo.

 

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

  • Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

  • Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance.

  • Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

  • Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A

⭐️ Your mission ⭐️

We are looking for a rigorous and hands-on accountant to help shape and run Alan's closing production process.

You will be part of our Financial Reporting area, focusing on Financial production. This area ensures that every number in our books is accurate, timely, and trustworthy, and serves as the source of truth for all financial decisions across the company.

Your role will be twofold:

  • Run our key accounting processes: Lead monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings

  • Ensure a feedback loop to drive process improvements, surface anomalies, flag data gaps, and actively contribute to making the closing faster, more automated, and more reliable over time. You will be a key partner to our Financial Operations and Data teams.

 

⭐️ What you will do ⭐️

  • Month-end close: own the end-to-end closing cycle across multiple legal entities; push pre-formatted journal entries into NetSuite, ensure completeness and accuracy, and deliver on schedule every month (target: J+5)

  • Accounting review: perform a thorough first-level review of balance sheet and P&L accounts at each close; identify unusual movements, resolve discrepancies, and ensure the overall reliability of the financial statements; build processes (routines, verification files, control procedures)

  • Account and bank reconciliation: maintain clean, up-to-date reconciliations across all balance sheet accounts and entities on a daily basis;

  • Contribute to finance transformation and system improvements: identify manual or repetitive tasks and collaborate with Financial Data to drive automation and reduce closing friction over time ; translate new business streams and P&L lines into accounting (acting as an interface between business teams and Finance)

description: 🤝  Qui nous sommes Chez Moka.Care nous réinventons la façon de voir la santé mentale en entreprise. Nous croyons en des équipes qui se sentent bien pour une organisation saine. Partager les nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouvelles offres à nos clients via des newsletters, des emails et des communications dans la plateforme RH. Créer des slides et des éléments de langage précis pour aider nos consultants à vendre nos offres et présenter nos nouveautés. Engagement utilisateurs Participer aux événements de lancement et stands dans les entreprises pour présenter Moka.Care aux salariés. Créer des posters, des vidéos, des goodies et tous types de supports visuels pour donner envie aux salariés d’utiliser Moka.Care. Communiquer auprès de nos utilisateurs sur les atouts de l'app et ses nouvelles fonctionnalités, via des emails dédiés, des notifications in-app...
